config.name: Vessel course and speed changes per minute
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) AS minute,
       countIf(course_change >= 10) AS "course changed 10 deg+",
       countIf(abs(speed_change) >= 1) AS "speed changed 1 kn+"
FROM (SELECT ts, track, speed, heading,
       speed - lagInFrame(speed) OVER w AS speed_change,
       abs(((toInt32(round(heading)) - toInt32(round(lagInFrame(heading) OVER w))) % 360 + 540) % 360 - 180) AS course_change,
       row_number() OVER w AS n
FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       toString(_json.mmsi) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[2])) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[1])) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.cog)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.sog)) AS speed,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.properties.navStat)) AS status
FROM dfe.`ais-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
WHERE heading < 360 AND speed >= 1
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY track ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW))
WHERE n > 1
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute

config.name: Vessels under way and stopped
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) AS minute,
       uniqExactIf(track, speed >= 0.5) AS "under way",
       uniqExactIf(track, speed < 0.5) AS "stopped"
FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       toString(_json.mmsi) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[2])) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[1])) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.cog)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.sog)) AS speed,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.properties.navStat)) AS status
FROM dfe.`ais-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute

config.name: Vessels changing course or speed most
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT track AS "MMSI",
       round(max(speed), 1) AS "Top speed (kn)",
       countIf(course_change >= 10) AS "Course changes",
       countIf(abs(speed_change) >= 1) AS "Speed changes",
       round(argMax(speed, ts), 1) AS "Speed now (kn)",
       round(argMax(heading, ts)) AS "Course now"
FROM (SELECT ts, track, speed, heading,
       speed - lagInFrame(speed) OVER w AS speed_change,
       abs(((toInt32(round(heading)) - toInt32(round(lagInFrame(heading) OVER w))) % 360 + 540) % 360 - 180) AS course_change,
       row_number() OVER w AS n
FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       toString(_json.mmsi) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[2])) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[1])) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.cog)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.sog)) AS speed,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.properties.navStat)) AS status
FROM dfe.`ais-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
WHERE heading < 360 AND speed >= 1
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY track ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW))
WHERE n > 1
GROUP BY track
HAVING "Course changes" + "Speed changes" > 0
ORDER BY "Course changes" + "Speed changes" DESC, "Top speed (kn)" DESC
LIMIT 15
